prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm caramel complexion, early 30s goddess, powerlifter bombshell physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — immense powerful thighs and shoulders built with real strength, a thick solid waist, overwhelming muscular bulk layered with soft curves everywhere, long wavy rose pink hair — wearing a minimal two-piece of a tiny bra top of two small cups on thin strings and a micro bikini bottom of one tiny low-rise triangle on thin side strings tied at the hips, both made of several gathered layers of soft ivory tulle, the material evenly tinted and softly diffusing so her own skin tone glows through it as a gentle blur, the rest of her body bare, her face and hands bare. Real photographic skin across her whole body, including where the sheer material veils it, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a small mole near her collarbone and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. The tiny garments show real material behaviour: airy tulle gathering in soft cloud-like folds over the small cups and the tiny triangle, the overlapping layers deepening to a milky haze, the thin strings pressing lightly into her skin. Pose: one hand on her waist, the other lifted to her chin, weight on one leg — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.

Jewelry: a fine gold chain looped around her thigh above the knee, a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.

Background: a sunny plaza at the foot of glass skyscrapers with pale paving, a low fountain edge, standard-height glass doors and benches, under a soft overcast sky with gentle diffused light, lit by natural light with soft shadows, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph.
